$comment: Which mdrag collection a save targets, keyed on the NEAREST ENCLOSING repo's
own `git remote get-url origin` — never the local directory name, which can
Two runtimes resolve this — mdrag's own Python callers and the Trigger.dev
workflows — and until this table existed the rule lived as prose in four
different skills, each free to drift from the others. This file is the
statement; each implementation's test drives itself from it, so 'the two
agree' is checked rather than asserted.
`repo_slug` is the repo name from origin (`basename -s .git`), NOT `org/repo`
— this table only ever needs the name, since collections are not scoped per
GitHub org. `no_match` cases assert the default when nothing in `routes`

routes.why: personal bot, kept separate from professional work

cases.name: a mapped repo slug resolves to its collection
an unmapped repo slug falls through to the default
a remote URL with .git resolves the same as its bare slug
an SSH-form remote URL resolves the same as its bare slug
an empty or missing remote falls through to the default
